test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The child was irritable/ because she had not/ soundly slept/ the previous night.
solution:
The correct answer is** "soundly slept"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment **"soundly slept" **is incorrect because it disrupts the natural word order in English for adverbs and verbs in this context.
 
• In the correct English syntax, the adverb **'soundly' **should come after the auxiliary verb **'had' **and before the main verb **'slept.'**
 
• Therefore, the corrected segment should read **"had not slept soundly."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"The child was irritable" **is grammatically correct.

 
 
• It correctly describes the child's state of being using the verb 'was.'
 
 
 
• **"the previous night" **is also correct.
 
 
• It properly specifies the time frame being discussed with no grammatical issues.
 
 
 
• **"because she had not" **does not contain a grammatical error on its own.
 
 
• It sets up a cause-effect relationship that is grammatically sound.
